title: HZB process snapshot (NOMAD uploader contract v0.1)
description: One experiment batch, fully resolved: every sample, every process step in order, and every parameter value written out. The file refers to nothing outside itself; steps point to entries of 'processes' in the same file. Generated by CI from a batch note and the process library, never edited by hand. Written as YAML or JSON. The NOMAD parser (nomad-hysprint, HySprintProcessSnapshotParser) validates every upload against this file and rejects versions it does not know. Breaking changes get a new version and a new schema file; the parser keeps reading older versions.

provenance.description: Where this snapshot came from. Stored in NOMAD for traceability; never needed to interpret the data.

source_note.description: Repository path of the batch note.

library.description: Repository path of the process library.

library_commit.description: Last commit that changed the library.

batch.description: Always a string, even if it looks like a number ('14').

properties.description: Properties shared by all samples of the batch (substrate, dimensions ...). Same field names as the 'Experiment Info' columns of the Excel experiment file.

processes.description: Every process recipe used in this batch, once, keyed by its id. Steps refer to these ids.

idPart.description: Part of a NOMAD sample ID. Letters, digits, '.' and '-' only: no '_' (it separates the parts of the ID) and no spaces.

scalar.description: Strings starting with = would be spreadsheet formulas; write the number instead.

fieldValues.description: NOMAD field name (with unit in brackets, e.g. 'Rotation speed [rpm]') -> value. The names are the column names of the Excel experiment file. Names NOMAD does not read are listed on the snapshot's entry (unread_parameters) and their values are not stored. Numbers are real numbers, never formulas or strings like '8E-7'.

variation.description: Human-readable summary of what differs from the default stack. Stored as the samples' and the sub-batch's description, together with notes and lab_comment.

sample_properties.description: Properties of the samples of this sub-batch; override experiment.properties.

samples.description: Sample numbers are unique within the batch.

nomad_id.description: Optional. The parser generates the ID as {lab}_{project}_{batch}_{sub_batch id}_C-{number}; if given, it must be exactly that.

omitted_steps.description: Steps of the default stack deliberately left out for this sub-batch. Informational.

steps.description: Process steps in the order they were carried out. Steps of different sub-batches become one NOMAD process entry when they use the same process and the same slot. The slot is 'run' if given, else 'excel_section' if given, else the step 'name'.

position.description: 1, 2, 3 ... in order of execution, unique within the sub-batch.

name.description: Step name in the stack, e.g. 'recombination layer 1'.

varied_from.description: Present when this step differs from the cell type's default: the default process id.

run.description: Optional label of the physical process run (one spin-coating session, one evaporation chamber load ...). Steps with the same process and the same run label are one NOMAD process entry; the same process with different run labels gives separate entries. Without it, steps are grouped by excel_section or name.

excel_section.description: Transitional: column group in the Excel workbook. If every step has one, process entries are ordered by its number; otherwise by the order of the steps.

method.description: Process type; decides which NOMAD process class the step becomes.

parameters_cleaning.description: Field names for Cleaning: the Excel experiment file columns. Numbered fields are shown with {n}, e.g. 'Solvent {n} name' accepts 'Solvent 1 name'. Generated by utils/snapshot_contract/update_contract_fields.py, do not edit by hand.
